column1: # Hot set of the race and its fixed placement: tools/hot_layout.py (its docstring says why and how), local.cfg.mk
# NATIVE_LAYOUT. Written by `tools/hot_layout.py derive`; curate the names, groups, patterns and contexts, then derive
# again (offsets, slots, sizes, ms). Offsets from the start of .text (0x8c010000); data_residue: the hot data block's
# offset (and residue mod 16 KiB), the hot code follows it: 0x3600 measured 7.34 ms of registration against 7.45 at
# 0x100 (18 October, hardware, scripted fast race); heap_residue: the image end mod 16 KiB (33ac4dd's).
# group: data (the hot data block), reg (registration), frame (enDjinn/KOS per frame), upd (the game update).
# contexts (reg): the inner loops and the per-object paths whose code shares the I-cache (derive minimises it).
